g.text: Integrated bulk multi-omics and single-cell mapping reveal a vascular-endothelial microenvironment program in LUAD
Integrated bulk multi-omics identifies a robust endothelial / vascular microenvironment signature.
Consensus modeling links MOFA latent biology with DIABLO predictive features.
Single-cell RNA-seq localizes the final program to endothelial and vascular-like stromal states.
Editable vector SVG: modular groups, independent labels, replaceable icons and panels
